audience: online sellers who read Click & Drop orders and carriers in their own Royal Mail account

useCases.title: List Click & Drop orders
useCases.text: Read orders from your own Royal Mail account, up to 100 per page. Use the continuation token to read the next page.

useCases.title: Open one order by its ID
useCases.text: Read one order by its positive numeric order ID. The read does not buy postage or generate labels.

useCases.title: Check the carriers on your account
useCases.text: Read the carriers available to your Click & Drop account before you choose a service for an order.

useCases.title: Review orders next to available carriers
useCases.text: Read orders and carriers for your account, then summarize both for a dispatch team.
